items.title: APRA warns data centres are straining insurance capacity
items.summary: The Australian Prudential Regulation Authority has highlighted data centres as a growing strain on insurance capacity in its latest risk report.

items.title: Bank of England Governor Warns Private Credit and Stablecoins Pose Risks
items.summary: Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey warns that Private Credit and stablecoins could create systemic risks before reaching traditional size thresholds.

items.title: Insurance Age HNW Article Inaccessible
items.summary: Insurance Age reporting on high-net-worth broker security could not be accessed due to site technical restrictions.

items.title: Polar Capital Appoints James Dowey as Senior Investment Specialist
items.summary: Polar Capital has hired James Dowey from BNP Paribas Asset Management as a senior investment specialist.

items.title: Digital-only banks could be forced to contribute to high street cash services
items.summary: A Treasury-backed review recommends new laws to protect face-to-face banking, potentially requiring digital lenders to fund high street facilities.

items.title: AM Best places Canopius ratings under review with positive implications following Samsung acquisition
items.summary: Credit rating agency AM Best reviews Canopius subsidiaries after Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance agreed to take majority ownership.
